Arthroscopic Surgery in Hyderabad

Minimally invasive arthroscopic surgery in Hyderabad. Knee, shoulder, ankle arthroscopy by Dr. Harsha at Yashoda Hospital.

Book Consultation on WhatsApp

Arthroscopic surgery, also known as keyhole or minimally invasive surgery, is a modern orthopedic procedure used to diagnose and treat joint problems with minimal disruption to the surrounding tissues. Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy utilizes advanced arthroscopy techniques at Apollo Hospitals, Hyderabad, providing patients with a quicker recovery and less post-operative pain compared to traditional open surgery.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does arthroscopic surgery take?
Simple procedures take 30-45 minutes. Complex procedures like ACL reconstruction or rotator cuff repair take 60-90 minutes.
Is arthroscopic surgery painful?
There is some discomfort, but it's usually less than open surgery. Pain is well controlled with medications and improves quickly.
